facts.event: Elise 在 Nest 外等候，心里清楚自己本该留下看新后更衣，却因羞愤离场。
facts.relation: Elise—Tilde（王妃与公主，敌对又暗自吸引）；Elise—父亲 Liran（服从与恐惧）
facts.numbers: 第一章场景：evensong 钟响前

facts.event: 回忆中 Liran 当众掌掴儿子 Conrin；Elise 私下认为 Conrin 活该，因为他确实举枪纵马、罔顾旁人。
facts.relation: Liran—Conrin（父子，国王当众羞辱王储）；Elise—Conrin（姐弟，隐秘的评判）
facts.anchor: Steadily, his rages had worsened, his restraint lessened.

facts.event: Elise 忆及两个姐妹的结局：Erelle 两年内如愿出嫁，Isuire 已死。
facts.anchor: In two years, Erelle was married, just as she had hoped. Isuire was dead.

facts.event: 等待的妇女中 Daegmar 抱怨脚痛，同样怀孕且月份更大的 Lady Cynefel 主动提出给她披肩或搬凳子。
facts.relation: Daegmar—Cynefel（同为孕妇的宫廷贵妇，彼此客套）
facts.anchor: said Daegmar, shifting from foot to foot as she held up her branch

facts.event: Tilde 现身庭院：没穿 Cynghal 低领束腰亚麻礼服，而是一袭 enker 绿长袍，散发披肩，发间编入常春藤与野花。
facts.relation: Tilde—Elise（被凝视者与凝视者）；Tilde—Cynghal 宫廷（以异族婚服示众）
facts.anchor: Instead, she wore a long robe of enker green.

facts.event: Lady Cynefel 低声解释这是 Merogian 婚服：新人被引到林中不同路径、须彼此寻得，绿色让寻找更难。
facts.relation: Cynefel—Merogia（出身 Merogian 却已归化）；Cynefel—Elise（被追问者与提问者）

facts.event: Cynefel 说 Ardweni 持镰刀与匕首，但 Nest 内禁携武器；Elise 随即高声警告若 Tilde 在 Nest 行凶全体 Merogian 连坐，话出口又为自己的迁怒羞愧。
facts.relation: Elise—Cynefel（公主威胁归化的 Merogian 贵妇）；Elise—Tilde（以连坐施压）
facts.anchor: Ardweni carry a sickle and dagger in their hands

facts.event: Elise 率先俯身把绿枝铺在地上，众女随之铺成 hedge-birch、rowan 与 pine 的枝毯；Tilde 踏枝走到 Nest 门前，抬手敲门，没有逃。
facts.relation: 众女—Tilde（以铺枝礼迎 queen）；Tilde—Nest/宫廷（主动入门受礼）
facts.anchor: Tilde did not run. She raised her hand, and knocked.
